summary: ManagedFile::uploadAjaxCallback() puts status messages in the widget's #prefix, which Xss::filterAdmin() filters, so markup in a message is lost (Olivero's SVG icons; in default_admin the Hide button). MR !16777 sends the messages with MessageCommand into a container it adds to the prefix instead. The lab and the owner's manual test found nothing wrong with it so far.

facts.text: fago kept the message where it was shown before, inside the widget area, for backward compatibility.
kentr asked whether the problem still occurs with the Default Admin theme now that Olivero is removed.
The lab answers yes: without the MR the Hide button is stripped from the error, with it the button is present and works from the keyboard.
A functional JavaScript test was proposed for the MR (FileUploadAjaxMessageTest.php); it is not in the MR yet.
The owner tested by hand (reported the evening of 2026-10-15) with keyboard only and VoiceOver: no problem with focus after Hide, and the error is heard once (FB-002, FB-003 met).

open.text: Other screen readers (NVDA, JAWS) and other browsers were not tried; the browser used for the manual test was not recorded.
